Morning home activities (pet care, coffee) persist, reinforcing the shift from strict 9-5 to flexible/hybrid. The 17:00 return is earlier than Days 7-8, suggesting some structure remains.

The absence of morning departure on Days 7, 8, and 9 supports this, but the strict 17:00 return on Day 9 (and 17:00-18:20 on other days) makes a fully irregular remote schedule less likely than a structured hybrid one. The 'blanket' movements are consistent with home presence but not diagnostic enough to override the return pattern.
